n01.roman: Rockstar ke mutabik, GTA 6 ka pre-load, device ke hisaab se, 212 GB tak hai.

n02.roman: TRAI kehta hai: Bharat mein ek mobile data user, mahine mein ausatan 28.4 GB chalaata hai.

n03.roman: Twist: poore 212 GB… yaani ek ausat user ka lagbhag saadhe saat mahine ka data!

n04.roman: 2 GB roz waala plan? To ismein poore 106 din ka data jaayega!

n05.roman: Paison mein? Companiyon ki ausat kamaai, ₹7.13 prati GB… yaani lagbhag ₹1,500 ka data!

n06.roman: Sabak: itna bada game Wi-Fi par download karo, aur 212 GB tak jagah pehle se khaali rakho.
